Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
El Chupacabra
Harbinger of Skulls
Capacity: 7 Group: 6
AUS NEC dom for obf
Sabbat. If El Chupacabra is ready during your master phase choose a methuselah; that methuselah discards a card from their hand. If you choose another methuselah, the card is discarded at random.

Why is this vampire "El Chupacabra"? It's the first name that came to mind given the somewhat random, "negative" effect he has. His ability can be used for good or bad, either creating fuel for Trochomancy, or helping someone who needs to cycle into cards (including yourself). It isn't super strong, but it combos with Constant Revolution and Harbinger tricks. AUS dom for works with !Ventrue, NEC dom works with Giovanni/Nagaraja, and NEC obf is good for Keystone Kine.

What do you think?

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
The special is strong, but I believe it will be only played in  (harbinger) deck because there is already so much good   vampire in the gr5-6. And he's not strong enough to make a deck based on him, like you could create with Asguresh.

I am not sure even harbinger crypt need him, but I haven't studied the harbinger crypt possibilities carefully.

Then again, that he have no evident use is not a problem in itself. It won't be a star, but he can serve nonetheless.

Messages.Author: Molloy

I like him. I don't think he opens up any new possibilities for G5/6 Harbingers, but his special is useful and appropriate. I don't think he'll generate table hate, since 99% of the time you'll choose yourself or your prey.

Sabbat. Animals, Wraiths and Zombies Molloy recruits or employs get an additional life.
